reviewer: Worker E independent read-only review of Worker D auth-only deployment and coordinator workflow
scope: Source/build policy/receipt/cleanup review before first genuine Windows service experiment. No native or Windows tests repeated.
checks: Hosted-only guard requires exact repository commit and original-source subtree, clean tracked native/original sources and new RUNNER_TEMP output
Original PE32 AuthServer, build receipt/source tree and completed ODBC files admitted against exact prior identity manifests; executable copy rechecked before start
Archive workflow admits exact bytes/SHA, unique bounded safe ZIP members and preserves failed/successful nonshipping artifacts
Original AuthServer policy configuration requires Encrypt=true, DesApply=true, protocol191021, normal payment checks, no fake auth, no DbServer/MapServer/checksum override
Disposable account/profile are independently generated in private temporary paths; SQL fixture output discarded and raw service logs never copied to artifact directory
Only known public disposable account exists in native probe; no arbitrary endpoint/account parameters; original native auth/login code compiled unchanged behind isolated Winsock adapter
Probe CMake static runtime matches pinned OpenSSL no-shared /MT build setting; Win64 console PE and OpenSSL runtime version identity recorded
Loopback-only native endpoint and exact owned-process listener ports tie exchange to unchanged original service; Windows inbound rule limits remote IPv4 and requires enabled firewall
Positive receipt requires exactly3 received frames and SHARDS_READY with empty shard list, nonzero bounded sends and complete socket cleanup
Wrong-password/missing-account controls require exact original failure command/reason, corrupt-frame injection changes outgoing bytes only in isolated transport
Overall passed requires all4 admitted controls, surviving owned original process, source unchanged, private files removed, process/firewall/LocalDB cleanup
Exception receipts permit symbolic errors only; public build logs and narrow redacted native JSON may be exported; no secret-bearing SQL output/private raw server logs
Job kill-on-close applies after process assignment; normal exception cleanup has direct-owned-child kill fallback and does not claim cleanup success if fallback required
Workflow runs only native-android and explicit auth-login trigger, does not cancel other workflows, and preserves bounded artifacts on failure

openssl_source_crosscheck.observation: VC-noCE-common selects /MT /Zl for no-shared libcrypto; generated probe requests MultiThreaded. Inspected pinned source, no Windows linker execution claimed.

limitations: MSVC compilation, actual LocalDB/AuthServer service login and four Windows controls remain first hosted execution gates
A positive auth-only exchange never establishes DbServer/MapServer handoff, checksum-policy acceptance, Android execution or live world authority
encrypted_account_login_verified may preserve a completed positive exchange when a later negative control fails; overall passed remains false
Job ownership begins after immediate Popen-to-AssignProcessToJobObject handoff; workflow job termination remains the outer hosted-runner interruption boundary
